name: SVC_SR_ADDRESSES
description: This table is used to store the service address of the SR.

columns.name: SERVICE_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and the primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SR_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS (SR_ID), the SR_ID that this address belongs to.

columns.name: ADDRESS_SOURCE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates source of address.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: The id of the address, depends on the address source.

columns.name: PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: The id of the party site, depends on the address source. This is a foreign key reference to HZ_PARTY_SITES (PARTY_SITE_ID).

columns.name: ADDRESS1
columns.description: The first line of the address where the service will be performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS2
columns.description: The second line of the address where the service will be performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS3
columns.description: The third line of the address where the service will be performed.

columns.name: ADDRESS4
columns.description: The fourth line of the address where the service will be performed.

columns.name: CITY
columns.description: The city where the service will be performed.

columns.name: COUNTY
columns.description: The county where the service will be performed.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: The postal code where the service will be performed.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: The state where the service will be performed.

columns.name: PROVINCE
columns.description: The province where the service will be performed.

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: The country where the service will be performed.

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: The timezone code of the address where the service will be performed.
